args.subject: Art Exhibition Last Friday
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I wanted to share that at the local art exhibition last Friday, the abstract paintings caught my eye, especially the vibrant colors and unique textures each artist used. It was a great evening exploring the contemporary works.

Best regards

args.subject: A Lovely Gesture from Last Night's Dinner
args.body:
Hi Iris,

I wanted to share a lovely moment from last night's dinner. At a cozy dinner at our favorite Italian restaurant downtown, we celebrated my parents' anniversary, and my sister surprised them with a beautifully decorated cake she baked herself. It was a heartwarming evening filled with laughter and love.

Best regards
